repo.name: babylon
repo.note: Babylon.js packages/dev/core, 2,673 non-test src files. Used for runtime-vs-type trap tasks: 0 runtime cycles, but a 2,260-file cycle group once type-only imports count, so every trap is a 'no' that source reading makes look like a 'yes'. 433 imports point at shader modules the build generates from .fx sources; each can only import Engines/shaderStore (which imports one enum), so none can sit on a cycle - generate with --allow-unresolved. Clone sparsely (packages/dev/, packages/public/, root *.json) and copy candidates-config/babylon-core.tsconfig.rie.json to packages/dev/core/tsconfig.rie.json.
